# Victor Jimenez portfolio

> Senior Product Engineer focused on the web, with 13+ years in web product engineering and technical leadership.

## About

I build web products end to end, across frontend, backend and release engineering. I have contributed to 60 professional projects across 11 sectors as part of project teams throughout my career. I work across architecture, integrations, CI/CD, technical SEO, performance, security and accessibility.

## Expertise

- Web product engineering: React, Next.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, PHP, Node.js and Python
- Architecture and integrations: GraphQL, REST APIs, migrations, payments, CRM and authentication
- CI/CD: repeatable builds, static analysis, browser verification and cloud releases
- Performance and technical SEO: profiling, caching, Core Web Vitals, search metadata and structured data
- Security and accessibility: audits, OAuth, SSO, permission controls, semantic interfaces and keyboard navigation
- Automation and technical leadership: requirements analysis, environments, release verification, code reviews and mentorship
- Platform specialties: Drupal, WordPress, Symfony, Pantheon, Acquia and WP Engine
